label: Diagram 5.3
caption: Diagram 5.3 Cavity walls excluded from provisions for cavity barriers
description: The drawing is an isometric section through a length of cavity wall, with a header 'See para 5.18' at top left. The wall is shown as two vertical leaves separated by a cavity. Green material closes the cavity at the top and around a rectangular opening cut through both leaves in the middle. Leader lines attach four labels: 'Close cavity at top of wall (unless cavity is totally filled with insulation)' points to the top closure; 'Opening' points to the central void; 'Close cavity around opening' points to the closure framing it; 'Two leaves of brick or concrete each at least 75mm thick' points to the two leaves at the base. To the right, a block headed 'NOTES' lists three numbered notes: 1, closing materials need no specific fire resistance performance; 2, meter cupboards allowed with conditions a (no more than two per dwelling), b (outer wall openings not bigger than 800×500mm each), c (inner leaf penetrated only by a fire-stopped sleeve not more than 80×80mm); 3, materials achieving class B-s3, d2 or worse may be placed within the cavity. A green footer reads 'Diagram 5.3 Cavity walls excluded from provisions for cavity barriers'.
